items.name: Giải phẫu nam trước
items.prompt: Anatomical muscle chart of a tall athletic adult man with fitness-model proportions (about 8 heads tall, broad shoulders, narrow waist, well-developed but natural muscles), FRONT view facing the camera, standing straight in a relaxed anatomical pose: feet hip-width apart, arms hanging slightly away from the body, palms facing forward. Clean modern medical textbook illustration, anatomical écorché figure (skin removed, superficial muscles visible), realistic muscle shapes and fine muscle-fibre striations, sharp clean borders between muscle groups, perfectly symmetrical, non-sexual, no genitals, no nipples, pelvis and groin simplified in grey. Full body visible from top of head to feet, centered, figure fills about 90% of the image height, nothing cropped. Background: solid pure black #000000, no floor, no shadow, no text, no labels, no arrows, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no border. COLOR CODING IS MANDATORY and must be exact: each muscle group listed below is painted in ONE flat, fully saturated colour with only subtle light-and-shadow shading (do not change the hue, do not blend colours between groups): pectoralis major (chest) = pure red #FF0000; deltoids (front and side of shoulders) = pure yellow #FFFF00; biceps and brachialis (front of upper arm) = pure green #00FF00; rectus abdominis and external obliques (abs and sides of the waist) = pure cyan #00FFFF; quadriceps and sartorius (front of thighs) = pure blue #0000FF; tibialis anterior and the visible inner calf of the lower legs = pure magenta #FF00FF. The trapezius visible above the collarbones is grey. EVERYTHING ELSE (head, face, neck, forearms, hands, wrists, elbows, knees, ankles, feet, hips and groin) = neutral medium grey #8C8C8C with the same anatomical detail and soft shading.
